attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each extra {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon (in addition to this attack's cost). You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

text.flavor: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.name: Magikarp
text.flavor: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like PIDGEOTTO to catch it mid-jump.

text.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Hyper Beam

text.flavor: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.
